programs.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programs.desc: Marcin Prokop sets off overseas once again.According to the stereotype, the United States is a place of endless possibilities, where everyone can fulfill their dreams.In the new season of the program, the host will meet people who have found the recipe for success in life.In this way, he wants to find out whether there is a set of universal rules that guarantee happiness.He will visit, among others, the Skid Row district in Los Angeles, the NASA headquarters in Pasadena, the desert in Utah and a gold mine in Colorado.In each episode, viewers will discover new stories and places.

In the California desert, in the middle of nowhere, Magda Wosińska organizes photo sessions of the biggest stars.She has lived in the United States for over thirty years and is currently one of the most respected photographers in the world.Born in Katowice, she started her career by immortalizing the skateboarders and motorcyclists community.Currently, famous actors, musicians and models appear in front of her lens, and the photos themselves are published, among others, on the pages of the New York Times.Magda Wosińska will tell Marcin Prokop how she managed to find herself and fight for her own place in this still male-dominated world.He will share his own thoughts about the Dream Factory.He will confess to which character traits he owes his success.
